d: We are looking for a detail-oriented, analytical, and results-driven Business Performance Analyst to support organizational performance monitoring, business analysis, and data-driven decision-making.

The successful candidate will be responsible for analyzing business performance data, tracking key performance indicators (KPIs), preparing management reports, identifying performance gaps, and providing actionable insights to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.

The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and reporting skills, a good understanding of business operations, and the ability to convert complex data into meaningful insights that support strategic and operational decisions.
Collect, consolidate, validate, and analyze business performance data from multiple departments and business units.
Monitor and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) against established business objectives and operational targets.
Prepare regular business performance reports, dashboards, and analytical presentations for management.
Analyze business trends, performance patterns, and operational metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
Conduct variance analysis to compare actual business performance against planned targets, budgets, and forecasts.
Identify performance gaps, operational inefficiencies, and potential business risks.
Develop and maintain performance dashboards using Power BI, Excel, or other business intelligence tools.
Support the development and implementation of KPI frameworks and performance measurement systems.
Work closely with cross-functional departments to collect performance information and ensure reporting accuracy.
Conduct root cause analysis to identify factors affecting business performance.
Provide data-driven recommendations to improve productivity, profitability, service quality, and operational efficiency.
Support business planning, forecasting, and performance review processes.
Monitor the progress of departmental improvement initiatives and evaluate their effectiveness.
Ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely submission of performance data and management reports.
Prepare presentations and analytical summaries for business reviews and management meetings.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting processes and improve data management practices.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
3–6 years of experience in business analysis, performance analytics, management reporting, or business intelligence.
Strong understanding of business KPIs, performance measurement, and operational reporting.
Proven experience in data analysis, trend identification, and performance monitoring.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, Power Query, and advanced formulas.
Working knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools.
Strong analytical and numerical skills with excellent attention to detail.
Ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into actionable business insights.
Understanding of business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
Excellent report-writing, presentation, and communication skills.
Strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to manage multiple reporting requirements.
Knowledge of SQL and database management will be an added advantage.
Accuracy and timeliness of business performance reports.
Effectiveness of KPI tracking and performance monitoring.
Quality of data analysis and management insights.
Timely identification of business performance gaps.
Accuracy and reliability of performance dashboards.
Effectiveness of recommendations for business improvement.
Contribution to operational productivity and business performance improvement.
Opportunity to work on strategic business performance initiatives.
Exposure to senior management and cross-functional business operations.
Professional development and career growth opportunities.
Opportunity to contribute to business excellence and organizational growth.
